description: Read one canonical Strategy SDK v1 project, its complete draft inspection, current immutable revision, hashes, and optionally its complete Python source.
code:
function origin(){return(process.env.ALPHALAB_API_ORIGIN||'http://127.0.0.1:8000').replace(/\/+$/,'')}
async function run(input){const id=String(input.project_id||'').trim();if(!id)throw new Error('project_id is required');const response=await fetch(origin()+'/api/strategy/projects/'+encodeURIComponent(id),{headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('AlphaLab API '+response.status+': '+await response.text());const value=await response.json();const available=typeof value.draft_source==='string';if(input.include_source!==true)delete value.draft_source;return{...value,source_available:available,source_included:available&&input.include_source===true}}
